vetSays.line: 🛡️ Irving, Enrique, Giulia, Tom and Fatima met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 driven off. Irving, Enrique, Giulia, Tom, Fatima are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Desmond just put down Buffering... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Adaeze just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
⚠ This one is different — bigger, and it didn't come alone. A Pack-leader veteran.

⚠️ 1 threats: Pack-leader Old Gavel (×2) — all here, all now.
Your party: Irving, Enrique. You are outnumbered — fight like it.
Irving explains, very reasonably, why the OTHER one is the problem. The Pack-leader Old Gavel and The Old Gavel (packmate) turn on each other. (Turncoat)
The Old Gavel (packmate) glares at The Pack-leader Old Gavel — YOUR argument made sense! It lays into its fellow monster! (Turncoat: 16)
The Pack-leader Old Gavel glares at The Old Gavel (packmate) — YOUR argument made sense! It lays into its fellow monster! (Turncoat: 19)

The Pack-leader Old Gavel is still frozen from your scream.
The Pack-leader Old Gavel falls.
📺 +20 style — dropped the Pack-leader Old Gavel!
📺 You brought down Pack-leader Old Gavel, Old Gavel (packmate). (The village watches the broadcast. Nobody blinks.)
📣 You brought down Pack-leader Old Gavel, Old Gavel (packmate).
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Enrique just put down The Influencer... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Farid just put down The Herald... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "You've gotten too big for the story. Ratings are GREAT, by the way — but you're threatening the narrative now. So the narrative is fighting back. Meet the PRODUCERS."
🛡️ Farid and Franz met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 barely walked away. Franz is hurt.
★ IDENTIFIED: Ground Elder. Creeping patches of divided leaves in shady spots. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
Arailym was watching. Now they know Ground Elder too.
📚 Village knowledge: Franz taught everyone about Ground Elder. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.
Fireside lesson: Franz passes around Ground Elder. Someone asks a dumb question. Nobody minds. That's how you learn.
The fire burns low. One new line in the journal: Ground Elder — named and noted.
Farid: "Ground Elder is coming back thick on the damp slope. Not new — but it's holding."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Raj just put down Big Loud... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Raj and Amina met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 barely walked away. Raj, Amina are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Raj just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📻 The producers name it: the Nielsen. Ratings embodied. It fights boring — and the crowd adores it for that.
